newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacia & Upjohn invest in MorphoSys.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacia & Upjohn invest in MorphoSys.

text.p: MorphoSys GmbH said Wednesday it has signed a six-year research alliance with Pharmacia & Upjohn, which could be worth over $50 million to the company.
The two-stage collaboration will focus on the discovery of lead compounds and the identification of new therapeutic targets for disease areas.
Pharmacia & Upjohn, said MorphoSys, will take a $5 million equity stake in MorphoSys, comprising an initial $2.5 million and a further $2.5 million in an initial public offering.
In the first stage of the collaboration, which will last two years, the company said Pharmacia & Upjohn will pay it $5.5 million in technology access fees and research funding.
Later, Pharmacia & Upjohn will pay an $8 million license fee to apply the technologies to specific targets and will provide a minimum of $12 million in research and development funding to MorphoSys.
Pharmacia & Upjohn was formed through a merger of Pharmacia AB and The Upjohn Company in 1995.

MorphoSys GmbH, based in Munich, Germany, develops and applies new technologies to the discovery of therapeutically active peptides and proteins and the characterization of novel targets for therapeutic intervention.
